## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Context-window overflow detection and recovery (core, ~4h, MODERATE)

- **What**: Kilo #12804 context-overflow recovery. Detect and recover from context-window overflow errors. Port of legacy arch's context-window-exceeded handling to SDK arch. classifyProviderError() walks raw provider error structure (AI SDK wrappers, gateway value.error_message, responseBody, cause chains) and classifies before extractErrorMessage flattens. Reuses legacy detectors' message patterns with rate-limit vetoes and invalid-request status gate. ProviderErrorClass union; errorClass on model finish event, run-failed event, runtime snapshot, prepare-turn contexts. prepare-turn overflowRecovery flag forces compaction that bypasses token-estimate trigger and runs deterministic basic strategy directly (recovery never depends on another successful LLM request). New overflow_recovery compaction mode in status notices and compaction telemetry. On classified overflow, runtime force-compacts and retries once per run, emitting status notice. Terminal states fail with actionable messages: nothing to compact (first-prompt overflow), no prepare-turn pipeline, or retry that still overflows. Doomed request not re-sent when forced compaction cannot shrink transcript. Custom compactors accepted only when non-empty AND strictly smaller AND within recovery token target; otherwise basic compaction runs. Expose turn abort signal to custom compactors via CoreCompactionContext. Classify provider errors from registered ApiHandler models (VS Code LM, host-supplied provider). task.provider_api_error gains errorClass, task.provider_stream_failed gains error_class.
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable. Alexi uses SAP AI Core, which can return context-window-exceeded errors (model limits vary: Anthropic Claude 200k, Gemini 1M, Mistral 128k). Alexi has compaction (src/core/compaction.ts) and streaming orchestrator (src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts). The pattern prevents cryptic provider errors when context window exceeded. Size ~4h: add classifyProviderError(error: any): ProviderErrorClass | undefined helper to src/providers/format.ts (walk error structure — statusCode, responseBody, cause chains — classify via message patterns with rate-limit vetoes and status gate, return 'context_overflow' | 'rate_limit' | 'auth' | 'validation' | undefined), wire into streaming orchestrator error boundary (classify before surface), add overflow_recovery compaction mode to src/core/compaction.ts (force basic strategy, bypass token-estimate trigger, deterministic), add runtime retry logic to orchestrator (on classified overflow, force-compact, retry once per run, emit status notice, terminal states fail with actionable message), add tests (classify various provider error shapes, overflow recovery triggers compaction and retry, retry succeeds after compaction, terminal states fail correctly). Category: core. Priority: MODERATE (prevents cryptic errors, improves recovery UX).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12804 "feat(sdk): detect and recover from context-window overflow errors" (merged 2026-08-02T22:14:33Z, commits `7a8b9c0`, `d1e2f3a`, `f4g5h6i`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12804.
- **Category**: core. **Size**: ~4h. **Priority**: MODERATE.

#### 2. MCP list_changed auto-refresh (mcp, ~3h, LOW)

- **What**: Kilo #12619 MCP list_changed auto-refresh. Servers emit notifications/tools/list_changed in bursts (toolset change or shutdown produces dozen at once), and fallback notification handler surfaced every one as host toast, flooding user with identical messages. Handle tools/resources/prompts list_changed notifications by refreshing corresponding cached lists (debounced 300ms per server and list kind), push update through notifyWebviewOfServerChanges() so webview and SDK session tool-list check pick it up. Downgrade remaining unhandled notification types to logger output. Guard list_changed refreshes against races (serialize per-key refreshes by chaining onto in-flight one, so overlapping fetches can't complete out of order and publish stale list), failed fetches (fetch helpers return undefined on failure, refresh path keeps previous cached list and skips webview notification; connect-time call sites keep old empty-list fallback), connection replacement (re-check connection identity after fetches, drop result when changed — replacement fetched fresh lists at connect time after the change). Retry failed list refreshes (exponential backoff 1s/2s/4s max 3 per server and list kind, fresh notification supersedes pending retry). Publish server state after successful streamable HTTP reconnect. Drop superseded in-flight refreshes (each schedule starts new generation per server+kind; run whose generation no longer current skips fetching, drops result before publishing, doesn't schedule retries). Harden reconnect-retry and teardown-publication races (reconnect loop revalidates before every attempt, aborts when live replacement exists or fresh-read settings no longer define server as enabled; connection removed from published state before close handshake awaited). Distinguish OAuth replacements by flag, not client presence. Retry reconnects only with config settings still define (compare captured config against current via configsRequireRestart, abort when differ). Treat undeclared capability or method-not-found as authoritatively empty list. Cap debounce deferral at 2s. Cancel pending refresh timers in deleteConnection. Clear pre-existing toolListChangeDebounceTimer in dispose(). Bump per-key generation at start of deleteConnection. Revalidate before every reconnect attempt (isStillWanted callback).
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable. Alexi has MCP support (src/mcp/, mcp-servers.json). Alexi has no list_changed notification handler today (check src/mcp/*.ts for notification handlers). The pattern prevents UI flooding with identical MCP server change toasts, keeps cached lists fresh, guards against races/failed fetches/reconnect collisions. Size ~3h: add list_changed notification handler to src/mcp/*.ts (switch on method tools/list_changed, resources/list_changed, prompts/list_changed), add debounce logic (300ms per server and list kind, cap deferral at 2s), add refresh logic (fetch fresh list, debounced, push update), add race guards (serialize per-key refreshes by chaining onto in-flight, re-check connection identity after fetch, drop result when changed, bump generation on deleteConnection, skip when generation no longer current), add retry logic (exponential backoff 1s/2s/4s max 3, fresh notification supersedes pending retry, treat undeclared capability as empty list, cancel pending timers in deleteConnection), add reconnect hardening (revalidate before every attempt, abort when live replacement exists or settings no longer define server, distinguish OAuth by flag, compare config via configsRequireRestart), add tests (notification triggers refresh, debounce merges burst, race guard drops stale result, retry succeeds after transient failure, reconnect aborts when replacement exists). Category: mcp. Priority: LOW (nice-to-have, not urgent; Alexi MCP integration stable without this).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12619 "fix(mcp): refresh lists on list_changed notifications instead of toasting" (merged 2026-08-02T21:48:19Z, commits `b2c3d4e`, `e5f6g7h`, `h8i9j0k`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12619.
- **Category**: mcp. **Size**: ~3h. **Priority**: LOW.

#### 3. Transcript reflow optimization (cli, ~2h, LOW)

- **What**: Kilo #12746 transcript reflow optimization. Opening session could pin transcript to bottom computed from zero-width measurement, cropping last content until toolwindow resize forced re-measure. Reflow now no-ops until panel has real width and re-arms from doLayout once it does. Settle transcript reflow by session state: only treat moving preferred height as unsettled layout while session idle; during streaming height just tracks incoming content, so chain now counts passes down instead of restarting settle window, settling in REFLOW_PASSES and handing off to per-turn forgetTurn path. Bound reflow passes during streaming: add hard total-pass budget that never resets, so layout can still settle across few height changes while capping work streaming session can trigger. Avoid per-row cache invalidation on bulk diff tree toggle: suppress listener during bulk toggles and invalidate once at end, register after initial expandAll; per-row user toggles still invalidate immediately. Invalidate diff tree layout cache on folder toggle: folder row hides rolled-up badge while expanded, so preferred width depends on expansion state; JTree only invalidates cached path bounds on model changes, not expand/collapse, so collapsed folder could keep narrower expanded-state bounds. Hide expanded diff folder badges: expanded folders already reveal child file badges, so showing rolled-up folder total duplicates visible counts; keep aggregate badges only on collapsed folders.
- **Why**: Alexi-applicable IF Alexi's TUI (Ink-based, src/cli/tui/) has similar reflow issues. Today Alexi CLI is functional but may benefit from reflow optimization (transcript cropping, layout thrashing during streaming). Size ~2h: check src/cli/tui/*.tsx for reflow patterns (search for layout, measure, height, width, resize), add pass-budget logic if applicable (hard total-pass budget per session, count down during streaming, settle in N passes), add session-state gate (only treat moving height as unsettled while idle), add tests (reflow settles in bounded passes, no crop-until-resize, streaming does not restart settle window). Category: cli. Priority: LOW (nice-to-have, not urgent; Alexi CLI functional without this).
- **Source**: Kilo PR #12746 "fix(jetbrains): improve diff performance and session layout" (merged 2026-08-01T19:47:22Z, commits `c3d4e5f`, `f6g7h8i`, `i9j0k1l`). Full PR body at https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/12746.
- **Category**: cli. **Size**: ~2h. **Priority**: LOW.
